text:
Sam Roth: quick flag 10: MarloweApps onboarding shows p95 spikes on short replies (p95 ~1.1s) and token consumption +25% MoM. majority traffic to rw-chat-13b-hosted with occasional fallback to dedicated when quotas hit. proposal: 1) canary short replies to rw-chat-6b-q4 2) preference route critical endpoints to their dedicated eu-central pool 3) enable prefix caching for the top cart/summary prompts. thoughts?

Maya Lin: agree, limiting to <=60 tokens should reduce quality risk. canary + eval harness is needed. recommend 4% initial traffic and a semantic-similarity check.

Jorge Alvarez: bench shows ~28% cost savings on rw-chat-6b-q4, p95 +~70ms vs 13b. safe for transactional messages. include prompt trimming template too.

Tess O'Neil: renewal flagged medium-high in 2 quarters if cost doesn't improve. I'll schedule an enablement call and capture their acceptance criteria. Also ask them for 5 representative prompts.

Sam Roth: infra note: need warm KV cache on their dedicated pool to avoid cold p99. deploy-bot can run a prime job. Also want alerts: stop if semantic_drop >3% or p95 delta >250ms.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Creating canary: route=marlowe/6b-q4-canary, traffic=4%, match=max_tokens<=60, fallback=rw-chat-13b-hosted. Warm-up job scheduled: prime top-180 prefixes over 15m. Alerts set: p95_delta>250ms, semantic_drop>3%. Link: https://console.redwood/inbox/canaries/2323456789

Maya Lin: eval harness snippet: {"canary":"marlowe-6b-q4","prompts":["status","add-to-cart","apply-code","order-summary","quick-reply"],"sim_threshold":96}

Jorge Alvarez: I'll monitor gpu_util, kv_hit_rate, serve_latency_p50/p95/p99. if kv_hit_rate <65% after warm-up we pause and re-prime.

Tess O'Neil: I'll run enablement Wed 11am and present the tradeoffs. collecting prompts now.

Sam Roth: plan: 48h at 4% with eval hook, then ramp to 25% if OK. Maya to push canary (EOD), Jorge to watch infra (48h), Tess to run enablement and capture approval (Wed). Keep this thread updated.

Maya Lin: canary pushed. eval harness kicking off every 15m. link: https://ci.redwood/builds/marlowe-canary-2323456789

Jorge Alvarez: warm-up complete. initial kv_hit_rate 79%, p95 +68ms. no alerts.

Tess O'Neil: customer PO ok to try 6b-q4 for short replies, requested a 72h review window and rollback checklist. sent 5 prompts.

deploy-bot: Canary complete at 48h: traffic=4%. semantic_delta=-0.9% (within threshold). cost_reduction_estimate=30%. p95_delta=+72ms. p99_delta=+120ms. No auto-rollback.

Maya Lin: results look good. recommendation: roll to 25% over next 24h, enable auto-prefix caching for top-400 prompts, create dedicated route for /v1/checkout and /v1/receipt pinned to their eu cluster.

Sam Roth: Tess, include these numbers in renewal materials; Jorge, prepare dashboard and rollback playbook; Maya, coordinate rollout ramp.

Jorge Alvarez: will validate steady-state kv_hit_rate >75% at 25% traffic and post metrics.

Tess O'Neil: added notes to Gainsight and scheduled 1:1 with Marlowe PO after 72h. will collect subjective feedback via a short survey.

Sam Roth: thanks everyone. closing after final 72h report. :rocket:
